Package com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.base

Record Class Winding

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.base.Winding
Record Components:
first - The first point in the winding.
second - The second point in the winding.
third - The third point in the winding.
public record Winding(GPoint first, GPoint second, GPoint third) extends Record
Represents a winding of three GPoints, typically used to define a triangle or a face in 2D geometry. This record provides utility methods for converting the winding to lists of points or vectors, reversing its order, and generating a string representation.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • reverse

      public Winding reverse()
      Creates a new Winding with the order of its points reversed. The new winding will have the third point as its first, the second point remaining as second, and the first point as its third.
      Returns:
      A new Winding instance with the points in reverse order.
